info.title: OpenServiceNOW API
info.description:
Phase 1 foundation API. The backend is authoritative for authentication, tenant scope and RBAC.
Every API response includes a server-generated X-Request-ID header; client-supplied request IDs are not trusted.
All MySQL BIGINT identifiers and cursor IDs are serialized as decimal strings to preserve precision in JavaScript clients.

tags.name: Incident Management
tags.description: First complete business process; communication, attachments and CMDB integrations are separate stages.

post.description: Creates the first organization, local administrator, membership, platform_admin role and audit event in one transaction. Permanently closes installation. NEW → IN_PROGRESS|ON_HOLD|CANCELLED; IN_PROGRESS → ON_HOLD|RESOLVED|CANCELLED; ON_HOLD → IN_PROGRESS|RESOLVED|CANCELLED; RESOLVED → CLOSED|IN_PROGRESS; CLOSED → IN_PROGRESS; CANCELLED is terminal. IncidentFields.description: Trimmed Unicode code-point limits. Omitted affected_user_id defaults to the session actor. Category/subcategory pairs come from metadata. Read-own callers can select only themselves.

IncidentAssign.description: Null clears a selection. Selected user and group must be active members of the current organization; if both are given, the user must belong to that group. Update concurrency uses the incident version.

IncidentTransition.description: ON_HOLD and CANCELLED require reason. RESOLVED requires resolution_code and resolution_description. Reopening RESOLVED/CLOSED to IN_PROGRESS requires reason and emits incident.reopened. Irrelevant reason/resolution fields must be omitted or empty. IN_PROGRESS and RESOLVED require an active assigned user.

IncidentPriority.description: Null or calculated priority clears override; otherwise requires nonempty reason and incident.priority.override. Changing impact or urgency restores the calculated priority.

IncidentPage.description: Bounded summaries, excluding large descriptions. Stable keyset order: newest=id DESC; oldest=id ASC; priority=priority ASC,id DESC. Priority pagination requires both returned cursor fields; no snapshot guarantee across concurrent edits.

oneOf.description: Visible shared work event; decimal-string actor/resource IDs, business occurred_at, incident_version, visibility, body/file_name or watcher/relation metadata as appropriate. INTERNAL events/payloads are excluded before public pagination.

IncidentHistory.description: Asynchronous shared activity projection by the real worker; newest source outbox event first, regardless of projection completion order. event_time equals business occurred_at, never worker receipt time. pending reports undelivered incident events; record writes remain durable while worker is unavailable.

NotFound.description: Resource not found in the current tenant

PayloadTooLarge.description: Request body exceeds the configured limit
